name: Zanma Bakki Another Queen
original_name: 斬魔伐姫アナザークイーン
source:
Modified humans known as fiends are created with the purpose of crossbreeding to make a new race.
To fulfill their desires, both they and Queen battle nightly in Hachimiya City.
Among this, a new powerful girl with a similarly modified body arrives to hunt the fiends. Her name: Another.
What more, Queen gets captured by this girl's sponsor, Gold Bag Pharmaceutical, and is confined in an underground facility.

Immortal bodies, powerful pheromones, tons of cum, cruel rape that takes their bodies to the limit.
These girls continue the fight against the fiends for the sake of the next generation.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE262975.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
被称为“魔人”的改造人，是为了通过杂交创造全新种族而诞生的。
为实现各自的欲望，魔人与Queen每夜都在Hachimiya市交战。
就在此时，一位同样接受过身体改造的强大女孩出现，开始狩猎魔人。她的名字是Another。
更糟的是，Queen被这名女孩背后的资助者Gold Bag制药抓住，囚禁在地下设施中。

不死的身体、强烈的信息素、大量的精液，以及将身体逼至极限的残酷强暴。
为了下一代，这些女孩仍在继续与魔人战斗。
